{{Conjecture|legends}}
The [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Pi-Lippa]] had a '''relative'''. Following Pi-Lippa's [[Death/Legends|death]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|26|Pi-Lippa}}</ref> in approximately [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]'' states that Pi-Lippa [[Death/Legends|died]] shortly after the [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], which took place in [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]] according to [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force]].</ref> the relative purchased the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] and her newborn son [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] as property<ref name="Secrets">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''</ref> from the inheritors of Pi-Lippa's estate.<ref name="Fact File">{{FactFile|70|SHM 1-4|Shmi Skywalker}}</ref> The relative did not want to grant Skywalker's freedom in spite of Pi-Lippa's intentions to do so.<ref name="Rise and Fall">''[[The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader]]''</ref> The Skywalkers were later sold as property to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]<ref name="CSWE Shmi">{{CSWECite|III|166|Skywalker, Shmi}}</ref> [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Visual">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]],<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|shmiskywalker|Skywalker, Shmi}}</ref> and taken to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="Jedi vs Sith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> where Shmi was ultimately freed after being purchased by the [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Cliegg Lars]].<ref name="Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pi-Lippa's relative was first mentioned in the [[1999]] reference book [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']], written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]].<ref name="Visual">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> In [[2003]], [[Star Wars Adventures Magazine 8|''Star Wars Adventures Magazine'' 8]] stated that Pi-Lippa's relative was the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]].<ref name="Adventures">[[Star Wars Adventures Magazine 8|''Star Wars Adventures Magazine'' 8]]</ref> However, this contradicts numerous other sources, which state that Shmi was sold to others before eventually being acquired by [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]] and then eventually lost in a bet to Watto.<ref name="Secrets" /><ref name="Fact File" /><ref name="Rise and Fall" />
